'''Laconio''' was a [[Philosopher/Legends|philosopher]] that [[Marn Hierogryph|Professor Gryphomarn]] quoted while on [[Metellos 3]] at the [[Metellos Exchange]]. In reality, "[[Professor/Legends|Professor]] Gryphomarn" was one of many aliases used by the [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] [[black marketeer]] Marn Hierogryph.
